headline: I build

profile.intro: Frontend engineer focused on React, with full-stack experience across Node.js, Express and MongoDB. I design, build and ship complete products — from the storefront a customer sees to the payment webhook nobody does.
profile.availabilityText: Open to full-time roles & freelance projects

about.heading: Engineer by trade, product builder by habit.
paragraphs: I'm a Frontend Engineer who builds with React and Tailwind CSS, backed by hands-on full-stack MERN experience. I care about clean architecture, fast interfaces and the details that make an app feel finished.
My recent freelance work is real commerce: two e-commerce storefronts with admin dashboards, payment gateways, inventory and order management — built end-to-end, from the data model to the deploy.
about.mission: Build software with precision and purpose — the kind that quietly works, scales, and earns trust.

highlights.description: Modular, readable code that stays easy to change.

projects.title: NutsBucket
projects.description: A full D2C storefront and operations dashboard for a premium dry-fruits brand. Customers browse, filter and pay by UPI; the owner runs products, orders, coupons, inventory and refunds from one admin panel.
highlights: Built a React storefront with cart, product filters and Cashfree checkout (UPI QR), backed by an Express API on Vercel.
Server-side price and coupon validation, signed webhook verification, and idempotent stock decrement inside Firestore transactions.
Admin dashboard with sales analytics, Cloudinary image uploads, order tracking, coupons, inventory audit log, refunds and CSV export.

projects.title: Cult Mecha
projects.description: A premium streetwear store with a complete back office. Firebase handles auth and data, Cloud Functions process Razorpay payments securely, and a multi-page admin covers catalogue, sizes, orders, returns and reports.
highlights: Developed a storefront (shop, product, checkout, account) with Google & email sign-in via Firebase Authentication.
Razorpay payments via Cloud Functions: server-computed totals, HMAC signature verification and a webhook safety net.
Admin panel for products & SEO, per-size inventory, order fulfilment, customers, returns, review moderation and sales reports.

projects.title: Job Portal
projects.tagline: MERN job board for seekers & recruiters
projects.description: A full-stack job portal connecting job seekers and recruiters, with secure authentication, job search and application management.
highlights: Built a full-stack Job Portal using the MERN stack with authentication and CRUD functionality.
Developed RESTful APIs using Express.js and MongoDB following a modular architecture.
Created responsive user interfaces using React.js and Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.tagline: This site — with its own content admin
projects.description: A responsive developer portfolio with a built-in admin panel to edit every section and generate a print-ready resume from the same data.
highlights: Designed and developed a responsive developer portfolio showcasing projects and technical skills.
Built reusable React components with a modern UI using Tailwind CSS.
Deployed the application on Vercel using GitHub integration.

bullets: Built two e-commerce storefronts end-to-end in React and Tailwind CSS, with admin dashboards for products, orders and inventory.
Integrated Razorpay and Cashfree payments with server-side verification using Firebase Cloud Functions and an Express API.
Deployed on Vercel with Firebase Auth, Firestore and Cloudinary image management.
Developed responsive full-stack web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB.
Built reusable React components and responsive interfaces with Tailwind CSS.
Designed and integrated RESTful APIs while managing application data with MongoDB and Mongoose.
Applied Git workflows, clean coding principles and component-based architecture throughout development.
